title: Microstructure and Mechanical Properties of the Ductile Al–Ti–Mo–Nb–V Refractory High Entropy Alloys
process_description: prepared by arc-melting method under argon atmosphere using high purity elements (Al, Ti, Mo, Nb, V). Ingots were re-melted more than three times to homogenize the composition.
